title: Queen Anne Melon - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Sweet Mini Melon Heirloom
description:
Heirloom Fragrant Melons for Your Garden - A Victorian Favourite!


KEY FEATURES
• Historic heirloom variety with a rich past.
• Produces highly fragrant, ornamental striped fruits.
• Attracts bees, enhancing garden biodiversity.
• Heat tolerant and relatively quick to mature (70-75 days).
• Versatile fruits with a potential lemony flavour for culinary use.


PLANT DETAILS
Type: Vegetables — Cucumis melo
Colour: Yellow flowers, orange/red and gold striped fruit
Season: Summer to Fall (flowers and fruit)
Growth Habit: Vining
Flavour: Lemony melon flavour, often described as mild; historically grown for fragrance
Time to Harvest: 70-75 days from planting


GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Full sun
Soil: Average, rich, and well-drained soil
Watering: Even and regular moisture
Spacing: Plant in hills of 3-4 plants, 6 feet apart
Height: 3 FT - 5 FT
Spread: 4 FT - 5 FT
Hardiness: USDA Zones 1-12 (grown as an annual in cooler climates)


CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Plant out 1-2 weeks after the last risk of frost, into a sunny, sheltered spot.
• Ensure consistent watering, especially during dry spells and when fruits are developing.
• Provide rich, well-drained soil, amending with compost if necessary.
• Melons are vigorous climbers; provide support such as a trellis or allow to sprawl.
• Protect young plants from slugs and snails.


WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x Mini Plug Plants
